source: FTA Decision No. 4 of 2026 · Record keeping
headline: YOUR SCANNED
RECORDS MUST

blocks.text: Any phone photo of the invoice will do.

items: Copy **every page, in order**. Partial scans are not accepted.
It must be **clearly legible** on screen, and the FTA gets the **passwords or keys**.
Outsourced storage? **You stay responsible.** Keep records **5 years** (real estate: 7).
